mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the prior month triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 0.5% for two consecutive months is associated with stronger corporate earnings expectations and positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant correlation with PAYEMS labor cost growth above 0.5% threshold (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in monthly GDPC1 personal consumption expenditures exceeding 2% from the prior quarter is followed by a negative S&P 20-day forward return as market anticipates cooling demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite GDPC1 QoQ declines of >2% (p-value < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly expansion in INDPRO supply index above 1% for three consecutive months reduces forward discounting of future earnings, producing positive S&P 20-day returns.
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns during INDPRO > 1% for 3 months (Rank IC > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 60-day forward return is expected to turn negative due to tightened financing conditions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive during high FEDFUNDS (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 5% for a month signals labor market slack, which is associated with a negative S&P 20-day forward return as investors anticipate weaker earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative during UNRATE < 5% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS demand growth exceeding 3% are accompanied by a positive S&P 60-day forward return as market anticipates robust corporate demand.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day returns during high RSAFS growth (Rank IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in HOUST (industrial production) and FEDFUNDS above their 2022 Q4 averages creates a conflicting macro signal that produces a negative S&P 20-day forward return due to heightened uncertainty.
regime_hint: conflicting signals: production up, rates up
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both proxies are above their 2022 Q4 averages (p > 0.05).
